name: eccang-reconcile
description: Send a platform settlement Excel file and auto-reconcile TikTok Shop / Tokopedia statements against Eccang settlement data — compare order counts and amounts, flag amount mismatches and one-sided orders, and generate a reconciliation report.

display.name: 易仓跨境对账
display.description_zh: 发一份平台结算 Excel，自动核对 TikTok Shop / Tokopedia 账单与易仓结算数据：比对订单数与结算金额，标出金额差异、单边订单，并生成可对外的对账报告。
display.description_en: Send a platform settlement Excel file and auto-reconcile TikTok Shop / Tokopedia statements against Eccang settlement data — compare order counts and amounts, flag amount mismatches and one-sided orders, and generate a reconciliation report.
